title: Mathematical Algebra: Sparse Matrices and Eigensolvers for NetworkX Parity
description:
Wave 1 (Foundation) of NetworkX-3.6.1-parity effort. Expand mathematical_algebra (mathematical/algebra/rs/lib.rs, currently 732 lines dense-only) with sparse-matrix and eigensolver support needed by later waves (spectral graph theory, centrality algorithms like PageRank/Katz/eigenvector, current-flow centrality, communicability). In-house numerics only, zero new external deps (crate has none, cannot touch Cargo.toml). All new code is f64, additive `// #region 🔖Name` blocks — do not modify existing Vec3/Mat4/Mat2/VecD/MatD/Mat3d code.

New regions: CsrMatrix (sparse CSR matrix + from_triplets/spmv/transpose/row/to_dense/nnz), AlgebraError (enum + Display + Error impl), Cholesky (dense SPD Cholesky + cholesky_solve), QrHouseholder (dense QR via Householder reflections), JacobiEigenSymmetric (full symmetric eigendecomposition via cyclic Jacobi rotations), LanczosExtremeEigen (sparse symmetric extreme eigenpairs via Lanczos + full reorthogonalization, seeded xorshift start vector), PowerIteration (dominant eigenpair via power iteration on CsrMatrix), ConjugateGradient (CG solver for sparse SPD systems), ExpmPade (dense matrix exponential via scaling-and-squaring + order-6 Padé).

Ownership: exactly one file, mathematical/algebra/rs/lib.rs. No other repo file touched. No git commit/stash/checkout. Tests extend the existing #[cfg(test)] mod tests block (with a mod long submodule for iterative-convergence tests on larger seeded sparse cases). Golden-value sanity tests for each new algorithm against hand-computable cases.

Gates before close: cargo build -p mathematical_algebra; cargo test -p mathematical_algebra; cargo clippy -p mathematical_algebra --all-targets -- -D warnings; cd mathematical/algebra && bun ./script.ts test.
